mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 650K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, a tightening labor market drives up wages, increasing inflation expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening labor markets are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production (INDPRO) growth rate above 5% YoY, indicating strong supply-side momentum, boosts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal savings (RSAFS) below $300B, signaling increased consumer spending, drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as retailers and discretionary sectors benefit.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when RSAFS is below $300B (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% YoY, a hawkish monetary stance combined with rising inflation leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in hawkish monetary periods with high inflation are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 7% is a persistent indicator of a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as a skilled workforce supports economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are not significantly higher when UNRATE is below 7% (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recoveries, a GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals a robust demand rebound, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors regain confidence in the economy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in post-shock recoveries with high GDP growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
